cards.back:
A person or animal in a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: tokoh
Example: The main character in the story is a clever girl.
cards.say: character. A person or animal in a story. The main character in the story is a clever girl.

cards.back:
The place and time where a story happens.
Bahasa Indonesia: latar
Example: The setting of the story is a forest at night.
cards.say: setting. The place and time where a story happens. The setting of the story is a forest at night.

cards.back:
The series of events in a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: alur cerita
Example: The plot has an exciting twist at the end.
cards.say: plot. The series of events in a story. The plot has an exciting twist at the end.

cards.back:
The main good character in a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: pahlawan
Example: The hero saved the village from the dragon.
cards.say: hero. The main good character in a story. The hero saved the village from the dragon.

cards.back:
A bad character in a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: tokoh jahat
Example: The villain stole the golden crown.
cards.say: villain. A bad character in a story. The villain stole the golden crown.

cards.back:
The voice that tells the story.
Bahasa Indonesia: pencerita
Example: The narrator explains what happens next.
cards.say: narrator. The voice that tells the story. The narrator explains what happens next.

cards.back:
The name of a book, story or film.
Bahasa Indonesia: judul
Example: The title of the book is The Lost Key.
cards.say: title. The name of a book, story or film. The title of the book is The Lost Key.

cards.back:
One main part of a book.
Bahasa Indonesia: bab
Example: We read the first chapter in class.
cards.say: chapter. One main part of a book. We read the first chapter in class.

cards.back:
The first part of a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: awal
Example: The beginning introduces the characters and setting.
cards.say: beginning. The first part of a story. The beginning introduces the characters and setting.

cards.back:
The last part of a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: akhir cerita
Example: I liked the happy ending of the story.
cards.say: ending. The last part of a story. I liked the happy ending of the story.

cards.back:
Something difficult that the characters must solve.
Bahasa Indonesia: masalah
Example: The problem in the story was a lost map.
cards.say: problem. Something difficult that the characters must solve. The problem in the story was a lost map.

cards.back:
The way a problem is solved.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemecahan masalah
Example: Their solution was to follow the stars home.
cards.say: solution. The way a problem is solved. Their solution was to follow the stars home.

cards.back:
Something that happens.
Bahasa Indonesia: peristiwa
Example: The biggest event in the story was the storm.
cards.say: event. Something that happens. The biggest event in the story was the storm.

cards.back:
The words that characters say to each other.
Bahasa Indonesia: dialog, percakapan
Example: The dialogue between the two friends was funny.
cards.say: dialogue. The words that characters say to each other. The dialogue between the two friends was funny.

cards.back:
The big idea or message of a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: tema
Example: The theme of the story is being kind.
cards.say: theme. The big idea or message of a story. The theme of the story is being kind.

cards.back:
The lesson that a story teaches.
Bahasa Indonesia: pesan moral
Example: The moral of the fable is to be honest.
cards.say: moral. The lesson that a story teaches. The moral of the fable is to be honest.

cards.back:
A short story with animals that teaches a lesson.
Bahasa Indonesia: fabel
Example: The tortoise and the hare is a famous fable.
cards.say: fable. A short story with animals that teaches a lesson. The tortoise and the hare is a famous fable.

cards.back:
An old story about heroes that may be partly true.
Bahasa Indonesia: legenda
Example: The legend tells of a brave warrior long ago.
cards.say: legend. An old story about heroes that may be partly true. The legend tells of a brave warrior long ago.

cards.back:
A children's story with magic and imaginary creatures.
Bahasa Indonesia: dongeng
Example: The fairy tale had a talking frog.
cards.say: fairy tale. A children's story with magic and imaginary creatures. The fairy tale had a talking frog.

cards.back:
A story about a puzzle that needs to be solved.
Bahasa Indonesia: misteri
Example: The detective solved the mystery of the missing cake.
cards.say: mystery. A story about a puzzle that needs to be solved. The detective solved the mystery of the missing cake.

cards.back:
The most exciting part of a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: puncak cerita
Example: The climax came when the bridge began to shake.
cards.say: climax. The most exciting part of a story. The climax came when the bridge began to shake.

cards.back:
The person who writes a book.
Bahasa Indonesia: penulis, pengarang
Example: The author wrote five books about space.
cards.say: author. The person who writes a book. The author wrote five books about space.

cards.back:
A short retelling of the main points.
Bahasa Indonesia: ringkasan
Example: Write a summary of the story in three sentences.
cards.say: summary. A short retelling of the main points. Write a summary of the story in three sentences.

cards.back:
To make a picture in your mind.
Bahasa Indonesia: membayangkan
Example: Imagine a house made of sweets.
cards.say: imagine. To make a picture in your mind. Imagine a house made of sweets.
